scenario: A cloud service provider (CSP) prepares its FedRAMP Authorization to Operate (ATO) package. A compliance officer uploads the System Security Plan (SSP) controls spreadsheet, runs a policy-based compliance assessment against the FedRAMP Moderate baseline, and generates a formal ATO readiness summary report for the Agency Authorizing Official (AO).
info_flow: csv-pipeline parses the SSP controls CSV and computes per-control-family compliance scores → compliance-checker assesses the scored results against a FedRAMP-baseline policy and classifies each family as COMPLIANT, NON-COMPLIANT, or UNKNOWN → reporting generates a structured ATO readiness summary report with an executive recommendation.
